thread:
alana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a short validation sprint to confirm our remediation playbook actually prevents recurrence. Proposal: 10-day validation window, owners for profiling, config canary, observability, and rollback. Who can pick which?

rachel: I can do the validation plan and test matrix. Will map inputs -> expected signals (p99, OOM rate, slab_free). Deliverable: test matrix + checklist by EOD.

oncall-bot: recent incidents: 2026-03-06, 2026-03-10, 2026-03-15. Pattern: incremental KV residency growth after long-running batches.

devon: I'll handle the profiling automation. Plan: automated heap snapshots + residency traces during a 24h soak on a staging pool. Will add a small analyzer to flag entries with lifetime > 72h. ETA: artifacts + summary in 72 hours.

samir: I'll assemble the canary config (softlimit 65%, sticky_ttl default->30m, slab_compact_freq increased). I'll also create a rollback FF that restores previous slab flags. Timeline: PR tomorrow morning, staging canary Thu.

oso: I'll own observability checks and the hypothesis detection rule. I'll create a metric for "delta_kv_residency_per_hour" and an alert if slope > 0.5%/hour for 6h. Also will add dashboard panels.

alana: Nice. Add also a signal for fragmentation: slab_free_ratio and fragmentation_index. If fragmentation_index > 0.6 raise medium priority.

devon: For collectors, use this command on hosts:
```
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/collect_heap --mode=light --out=/tmp/heap-$(date +%s).tgz
./scripts/kv_tracer --duration=600 --format=compact --out=/tmp/kv.json
jemalloc-config --stats > /tmp/jemalloc.txt
```
I'll push a small wrapper that uploads to the postmortem artifacts bucket.

rachel: For the test matrix: 1) baseline soak (no changes) 24h, 2) canary with sticky_ttl=30m 48h, 3) canary with softlimit 65% + slab compaction 5m 48h. For each run we check p99, OOM count, slab_free, and avg eviction rate.

samir: Risk estimates: sticky_ttl change = low (evictions might increase), softlimit change = medium (can increase immediate evictions), slab compact freq = medium-high (CPU impact). I'll annotate in the PR.

oso: I'll wire the alerts to the FF so we can abort the rollout automatically if p99 increases by >10% or OOM_count > 0 in the canary pool.

alana: Good call. Also add a probe that runs frag-scan daily during the validation window and records results. Command snippet: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://infra.internal/frag/probe -d '{"pool":"staging-gpu-*","duration":300}' | jq .result > /tmp/frag.json
```

devon: I'll ensure traces include per-request KV touchset so we can identify long-lived keys. We'll run an analyzer to output top-20 candidates for TTL enforcement.

rachel: Owners recap: rachel=test matrix & plan (EOD), devon=profiling automation + artifacts (72h), samir=canary config + PR (tomorrow), oso=alerts & dashboard (today). Validation window: 10 days starting 1777728000 (mon morning). Sync checkpoint: daily async updates in this thread for first 5 days, then every other day. Final sign-off: two-week retro.

alana: One more ask: add expected rollback instructions in the PR description. If we see increased latency or OOMs, we revert the FF and restore slab flags.

samir: Will include a one-click rollback runbook and the exact git revert commands.

oso: I'll also create a lightweight regression test that injects synthetic long-lived KV entries into staging to validate eviction behavior.

devon: Note: when running jemalloc stats capture, include MALLOC_CONF=lg_dirty_mult:0 to make fragmentation signals clearer.

alana: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Let's keep updates short in this thread. If anyone needs an extension on ETA call it out now.

rachel: All good from me. I'll post the matrix shortly. :memo:

samir: PR up in 30m.

oncall-bot: scheduled validation window start: 1777728000 (2026-03-22 09:00 UTC).
